interventions.description: Replace flexible delineators with concrete curbs or planters to provide a more substantial physical barrier between vehicles and the pedestrian/cyclist zone.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting specifically for the sidewalk to enhance safety and security after dark.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Temporary Protected Walkway
interventions.description: Install a temporary, water-filled barrier or similar protection to create a safe walking path around the construction site.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with high-visibility 'continental' markings to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Street trees
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide a physical and psychological buffer.
